newsitem.title: USA: Connect says Bridge replaces Kehler as CEO.
newsitem.headline: Connect says Bridge replaces Kehler as CEO.

text.p: Connect Inc on Wednesday said it has named Chairman Gordon Bridge as the company's new president and chief executive officer, replacing Thomas Kehler, who has resigned for personal reasons.
Bridge joined Connect, a developer of industrial strength, scaleable software for Internet-based interactive commerce, in November 1995.

From 1988 to 1995, Bridge held executive positions with AT&T Corp, including President of AT&T Conputer Systems, President of EasyLink Services, President of AT&T Consumer Interactive Services, and Vice President, Corporate Strategy.
Prior to AT&T, Bridge served for 23 years with IBM Corp in various positions, including Vice President of Marketing and Vice President of U.S. Sales.
